findings.summary: Dark preference does not change the light interface
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot remains white and turquoise, and computed color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: Some text fails contrast requirements
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two failing color-contrast nodes on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG contrast in default and high-contrast conditions.

findings.summary: State changes lack continuity cues
findings.evidence: DOM and interaction inspection found no evidence that navigation or major state changes use View Transitions.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Overlay positioning is implemented without semantic anchored primitives
findings.evidence: The visible consent overlay uses neither dialog/popover nor anchor-positioning primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog/popover and anchor positioning where overlays relate to controls, retaining fallbacks.

findings.guidanceId: avoid intrusive interstitial popup content first
findings.summary: Consent panel obscures much of the first mobile viewport
findings.evidence: The load screenshot shows a consent panel covering roughly the lower 44% of the 390x844 viewport before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking consent surface while preserving equally prominent Reject and Accept actions.

findings.summary: Consent overlay lacks dialog or popover semantics
findings.evidence: The panel is visually modal, but the DOM probe reports zero dialog roles, dialog elements, and popovers.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the consent surface with dialog/popover semantics, labelled controls, focus management, and platform dismissal.

findings.summary: Promotional and consent chrome competes with shopping content
findings.evidence: The first viewport combines a coupon strip, dense dual navigation, promotional hero, shipping strip, and a large consent panel.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce simultaneous promotional chrome and preserve more of the first viewport for products and primary shopping actions.

findings.summary: No component-query adaptation was detected
findings.evidence: CSSOM inspection found zero @container rules on a component-rich responsive retail homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reusable product, navigation, and promotion components that appear in varied slots.

findings.summary: Mobile loading and responsiveness are poor
findings.evidence: Trace measured FCP 3.78s, LCP 3.91s and 959ms TBT; Lighthouse measured LCP 5.67s and 1,407ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise LCP content, break up long tasks, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

findings.summary: Images do not reserve intrinsic space
findings.evidence: The image audit found all 51 images lacked width and height attributes; Lighthouse CLS was 0.070, below poor but exposed to shift risk.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio on every image and retain stable placeholders.

findings.summary: Large long tasks block the main thread
findings.evidence: The trace found seven long tasks, a 679ms longest task, and 959ms total blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Split long tasks, schedule work by priority, and defer low-value hydration and analytics.

findings.summary: The homepage ships a large script-heavy request graph
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 211 requests and 3.43MB transferred, including 137 scripts and 2.81MB of script transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce startup requests, defer parser-inserted scripts, and prioritise only critical assets.

findings.summary: Substantial JavaScript is unused during initial load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1,304KiB of unused JavaScript on the observed homepage load.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by route and feature, remove duplicate/legacy bundles, and conditionally load optional dependencies.

findings.summary: Images and page regions lack accessible semantics
findings.evidence: Image audit found 14 images without alt; the rendered page has no h1 and only a header landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide meaningful alt text, a clear h1, semantic regions, and accessible names for all interactive controls.

findings.summary: Text contrast failures reduce legibility
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility found two color-contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Update color tokens and verify text/control contrast in all preference modes.

findings.summary: Heading and landmark structure is incomplete
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no h1, h2, h3, main, nav, or footer elements; only header was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical heading hierarchy and semantic main/nav/footer landmarks while preserving visible focus.

findings.summary: Image alternatives are incomplete despite good mobile reflow
findings.evidence: The mobile layout had no horizontal overflow and Lighthouse target-size passed, but 14 of 51 images lacked alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the responsive viewport and target sizes, and add appropriate alt or empty alt to every image.

findings.summary: The homepage logs runtime errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a Google identity AbortError and a not-signed-in error during load.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle expected identity-provider cancellation without console errors and isolate optional auth startup.

findings.summary: Asset markup omits intrinsic image dimensions
findings.evidence: The document has a valid doctype and charset, but all 51 inspected images omit width and height.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic image dimensions and responsive sources from the rendering pipeline.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and browser lifecycle issues remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported deprecated API use, DevTools inspector issues, and four bfcache blockers.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated APIs, resolve inspector issues, and make unload/lifecycle code bfcache-safe.

findings.summary: Much shopping content depends on JavaScript and many anchors are non-crawlable
findings.evidence: Discoverability found only 25% raw/rendered word coverage, and the DOM probe found 34 of 61 anchors use javascript: URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Render primary category/product content in HTML and use real href destinations for navigation.

findings.summary: CSP and response policies are incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, and nosniff are present, but CSP only declares frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy is absent, and Referrer-Policy is no-referrer-when-downgrade.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive script/style CSP, Permissions-Policy, and strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy.

findings.summary: The initial page has a very large cross-origin footprint
findings.evidence: HAR classified 208 of 211 requests and 3.43MB as cross-origin relative to m.shein.com; tracker probe saw 14 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate first-party origins, delay analytics until consent, and remove or batch non-essential calls.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are only partially deployed
findings.evidence: Headers show HSTS and frame restrictions, but no Permissions-Policy and a CSP limited to frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrictive CSP directives, Permissions-Policy, modern frame-ancestors enforcement, and stronger referrer isolation.

findings.summary: Most rendered content is absent without JavaScript
findings.evidence: The raw HTML contains only 25% of rendered content words; crawler and browser screenshots differ substantially.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core navigation, categories, promotions, and product links with progressive enhancement.

findings.summary: Login-linked coupon framing creates promotional pressure
findings.evidence: The first content announces a 50% coupon with coupons confirmed only after login before users reach products.
findings.suggestedFix: State eligibility and account requirements plainly and avoid urgency or oversized incentives ahead of core content.

findings.summary: Image and script delivery is not sufficiently optimised
findings.evidence: Image audit found 51 missing dimensions, 39 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, and 10 without responsive sources; HAR transferred 3.43MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media, add responsive AVIF/WebP sources, and reduce script bytes.

findings.summary: Startup performs excessive script work
findings.evidence: The page loads 137 scripts and trace records seven long tasks with 959ms blocking time before a user journey begins.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer background/analytics work, conditionally load features, and schedule non-critical work after interaction or idle.

findings.summary: Third-party transfer dominates the page budget
findings.evidence: HAR reports 3.43MB cross-origin transfer, with the largest script origin contributing 2.69MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget and remove, consolidate, or defer the largest external bundles.

findings.summary: The shopping journey is not exposed as structured agent capabilities
findings.evidence: Probe found no WebMCP surface; the accessibility tree audit failed and many links depend on javascript: URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose safe search, product-detail, cart, and account actions through structured forms or WebMCP tools with validated schemas.

findings.summary: The initial page has an unusually large heap footprint
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contained 1,200,901 nodes and 103.8MB self size for the initial mobile homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce loaded modules and retained application state; profile dominant native/code allocations and lazy-initialise optional features.

taskList.title: Cut startup JavaScript and main-thread work
Restore semantic, crawlable HTML and accessible structure
Reduce intrusive promotional and consent chrome
Add user preference theming and contrast fixes
